bill.title: Individual income tax: credit; credit for owners of agricultural assets who sell or rent agricultural assets to beginning farmers; provide for. Amends 1967 PA 281 (MCL 206.1 - 206.847) by adding sec. 281.   TIE BAR WITH: HB 6437'26

posted_text:

MI HB 6438 — Michigan Farmers Get a New Tax Break

Michigan farmers who sell or rent land to beginning farmers could qualify for a new tax credit. The bill creates a credit up to the amount on a certificate issued by the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development, but only if the department has issued a certificate. To claim the credit, taxpayers must attach both the certificate and proof the agreement was active during the tax year. ...
